title: app-shell nav: an `app.nav` entry with no explicit `label` resolves to its target's CURRENT label at render time (view label, else object/dashboard label, else the machine name) — so a renamed display name shows in the nav on the next load without any stored 'inherited vs manual' state (cloud#2021 ruling: sync, refresh is acceptable)
body:
Filed by the director seat (objectstack #12708, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`) executing decision batch #161 item 1 — maintainer's word on cloud#2021: 「2021 可以接受有些修改刷新才生效」 ⇒ **sync**, with render-time inheritance instead of stored state; a refresh is enough.

## What lands (objectui half, first)

The console's app navigation renders an `app.nav[]` entry whose `label` is **absent** by resolving, at render time, the label of the target it opens: the VIEW's label when the entry names a view and that view is labelled; else the object's / dashboard's label; else the machine name (today's backstop). An entry whose `label` is **present** renders it verbatim — an author's explicit nav label is never overwritten. No reactivity is required: the maintainer accepts that a rename shows on the next page load.

The spec already declares this default — objectstack `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts:189`: `label: z.string().optional().describe('Nav entry label (defaults to the target label/name)')` — and applies no default of its own (`safeParse` of an unlabelled entry returns no `label` key), so the promise is the renderer's to keep.

## Then the cloud half (on cloud#2021, `Blocked-by:` this card)

cloud's `apply_blueprint` (PR cloud#2349, `1ebab55c`) currently MATERIALISES the inherited label into metadata at apply time; once this card lands it stops writing a label the author did not give (explicit author labels are still written), so the entry stays inheritable and follows later renames. Apps already materialised keep their stored label (no migration).

## Acceptance

- A nav entry with no `label` pointing at a view labelled 客户管理仪表盘 renders 客户管理仪表盘; rename the view's label, reload: the nav shows the new name.
- A nav entry with an explicit `label` renders that label regardless of the target's label.
- The machine-name backstop still renders when the target has no label at all.
- ⛔ No new metadata member, no stored 'inherited' flag.

## Refs

cloud#2021 (ruling) · cloud#2349 (the applier half already landed) · cloud#1452 ruling (product decisions on cloud, objectui executes)

Dedup terms: `nav label inherits target label render time`, `app.nav label defaults to view label`, `navigation rename follows display name`
